policy.classification_rule: Recognized headings supply the default. Only a clear leading preferred marker or whole-line preferred predicate may override the explicit heading. Parenthetical/bracketed or subordinate preferences, mandatory/mixed wording and ambiguous bare preferred endings retain the explicit section class. No semantic fragments are invented.
policy.source_unit_definition: Selected fragments are exact prefixes of whitespace-normalized stored source units. Generated metadata/section labels are not source units.

j12_correction.cause: Classification, not token-budget truncation: missing desired-section aliases and an overly broad preference override.
